fields.summary_ko.0: Seagate Technology (STX) has secured most of its supply volume through long-term contracts with data center customers through 2028, with December quarter revenue expected at $480M (±$100M), up from prior quarter's $420M.
fields.summary_ko.1: Seagate's operating margin of 48.9% (fiscal Q1 2027) represents substantial improvement from 26.9% year-over-year, with revenue growth rate of 44.4% and net profit multiple of 26.3x, outpacing Apple (growth rate 15.1%, multiple 38.7x).
fields.summary_ko.2: Apple faces memory constraints, with December quarter revenue growth projected at 7-10%, and gross margin expected to decline to 45-46% from prior quarter's 47.9%.
